applies_to: Regin Corrigo 5.0 ventilation controllers for air handling units (supply/extract fans, heating/cooling sequences, heat recovery).
summary: Corrigo 5.0 is Regin's pre-programmed ventilation controller. Its EDE file lists 840 objects: run mode and manual/auto selectors for the unit, fans, dampers, pumps and sequences, supply/extract/room setpoints and outdoor compensation curve, fan pressure and flow setpoints, measured temperatures, pressures and flows, about 200 alarm BVs with A/B/C sum alarms, schedules, a holiday calendar and notification classes.
notes: Temperature and pressure objects marked "(configurable)" in the EDE take the unit set in the controller (for example °C or °F), so no unit is given for them.
Which objects carry values depends on the configured functions (control mode, fan type, sequences, expansion units).
Descriptions are short forms of the EDE descriptions.
The EDE lists the device instance and name as placeholders (@DeviceID / @DeviceName).
The EDE file does not say which BACnet data link (BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP) the controller uses; check the model data sheet.

integration.summary: Use MV 30788 AirUnitAutoMode to run the unit (off, manual, auto or a forced speed) and AV 30811 SupplySetpoint for the supply air setpoint in constant supply air control. Read MV 40428 UnitMode and MV 40429 UnitModeControl for what is running and why, the supply and outdoor temperatures, and BV 20008/20009 for A- and B-alarms. BV 10000 acknowledges all alarms.

minimum_points.why: Unit run mode: off, manual, auto or fixed speed

minimum_points.name: UnitMode
minimum_points.why: Actual run mode: stop, start-up, low/normal/high

minimum_points.name: UnitModeControl
minimum_points.why: What triggers the current run mode

integration.enable: MV 30788 AirUnitAutoMode sets the unit running mode (1 OFF, 2 Manual, 3 AUTO, 4-6 low/normal/high speed). MV 30796 ExternalControl selects extended-run speeds; MV 30797 AirUnitServiceStop stops the unit with top priority.
setup: MV 30808 VentControl selects the temperature control mode (constant supply, outdoor compensated, cascade room, ...); AV 30811 only applies to constant supply air control.
gotchas: Setpoints and configuration values are stored in the controller; do not write them cyclically.
Time channel status MVs (TC_..._Status) can force fan speeds on or off; leave them on Auto for schedule control.
